contea di ritrovamento: Cheshire West and Chester (Inghilterra e Galles)
OFVIRIL which is an abbreviation of the maker Virilis

A large base and body shard of decorated Roman Samian Ware/Terre Sigillata pottery. The rest of the vessel has broken off. It is semi-circular in plan. The fabric is very hard (it rings when knocked), is light orange in colour and has an orange/red 'satin' gloss slip on both the inner and outer surface.
